description.value: Nanoose Place Community Centre is a volunteer-run, non-profit hub in Nanoose Bay that has served the local community since 1992, offering fitness classes, pickleball, floor curling, seniors programs, and rentable event halls. It is operated by the Nanoose Bay Activities and Recreation Society (NBARS) and also functions as a designated emergency reception centre for the area. The surrounding grounds include Eswyn's Alpine & Rock Garden, a volunteer-established feature that adds a quiet outdoor element.
